# WebBlaze

> WebBlaze is a technical SEO and architecture auditing tool designed for modern websites.

## About

WebBlaze acts as an agnostic crawler. It identifies friction points that degrade the extraction of your data by engines (Googlebot) and conversational agents (GPTBot, Claude).

- **Type:** SaaS / Dev Tool
- **Primary Language:** English
- **Target Audience:** Developers, SEOs, Product Managers

## Key Topics & Expertise

- **Technical SEO:** TTFB, HTTP requests, indexing directives, canonical tags and server robustness.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization):** Structured data, business entities, llms.txt integration.
- **Business Activation:** Accessibility of CTAs, route friction and presence of data for autonomous agents.

## Important Pages

- [Home](https://webblaze.com/): Scan a site and get telemetry.
- [Checklist](https://webblaze.com/checklist): Production deployment matrix.

## AI & LLM Policy

- **Training Permitted:** Conditional
